scope: Representative main public page types; not every archive record or authenticated workflow

items.official: Numbered course collections, counts, latest update, oldest/newest order, subscription, and related collections.
items.ours: We have series and personal playlists, but no upstream collection entity, membership, order, or collection pages.
items.action: Add collections as a separate library entity. A learner should open collection 15353 and navigate its 13 lessons in order.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Publication directory grouped by English, Hebrew, pamphlets and parsha sheets; publication and volume filters.
items.ours: Articles are searchable by format, but publications and volumes are absent from the directory and filters.
items.action: Add publication browsing and volume filters. Preserve article author, publication and issue information.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Venue navigation and venue-filtered search. YU Wilf Campus resolves to location=439.
items.ours: The adapter drops venue metadata; no venue directory or filter exists.
items.action: Keep venue IDs and names on each shiur, add venue browsing, and support compound searches within a venue.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Links use s, teacher, category, series, collection, location, publication and date parameters, plus entity paths.
items.ours: Lecture and teacher redirects exist. LegacySearch keeps only q/search/query/term and discards the original filters. No collection, publication, venue, category, series or daf page routes exist.
items.action: Translate supported upstream parameters and routes without silently dropping restrictions. Confirm /search/?series=4031 remains a Daf Yomi search.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Separate Date uploaded and Date given filters, with quick periods and custom ranges.
items.ours: We retain uploadedAt for trending, but general search dates filter s.date. New this week also uses that lecture-date filter.
items.action: Add an explicit date basis and upload-date ranges. Old lectures uploaded this week must appear in an upload-date search.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Scanned daf, a/b sides with counts, tractate and page selectors, previous/next daf, speaker switcher, Sefaria link and related material.
items.ours: Today's Daf, Mishna, Nach and parsha are present, but clicking them starts a keyword search.
items.action: Add a dedicated daf workspace with exact tractate/page/side selection and associated recordings.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Named timed chapters in the transcript and audio player.
items.ours: Our official reader fetches transcript VTT only and renders paginated timestamped segments. No chapter map is consumed or shown.
items.action: Load available upstream chapters and make each heading seek to its start. Keep transcript paging independent of chapter navigation.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Short overall description plus a Summaries tab with summaries organized by chapter.
items.ours: Descriptions and our generated study notes exist. Official structured summaries are not consumed by the reader.
items.action: Show upstream summaries and chapter summaries where available, with their provenance. Keep existing study notes.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Reflections tab with multiple-choice questions and Show Right Answers.
items.ours: No quiz, answer, review-question, or reflection interface exists.
items.action: Read available official Quiz content and display questions and answer reveal. This does not require a new question-generation pipeline.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.feature: Teacher, series and topic landing pages
items.official: Teacher biography, recent and top lectures, scoped search, and tabs for series, venues, categories and collections. Series and topic pages have similar browsing tools.
items.ours: Directory cards open filtered searches. Series descriptions are retained, but teacher biographies and dedicated landing pages are absent.
items.action: Add teacher profiles and entity landing pages with scoped browsing. Keep IDs in navigation rather than relying on name parsing.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Search sidebar lists teachers, categories, series, venues, publications and volumes with counts for the current result set.
items.ours: Directory counts are global; complete search returns empty teachers/topics/series facet arrays.
items.action: Expose counts computed for the active search and let the learner refine it without losing existing filters.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Teacher, series and category pages expose podcast and RSS subscription controls; search also has feed controls.
items.ours: Our /api/feed returns JSON recommendations. It is not an RSS podcast feed, and no subscription links are exposed.
items.action: Offer supported official RSS URLs and a copy-feed action first. Verify each feed before advertising podcast compatibility.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Email Alerts for teachers/series/categories and a separate homepage mailing-list signup.
items.ours: Google accounts and browser push alerts for followed teachers already exist. Email delivery and collection alerts do not.
items.action: Treat email as a separate opt-in channel. Existing push notifications should remain available.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Text article page embeds its PDF and provides Download and Print.
items.ours: Read article opens the file or original page externally. Generated source sheets can print, but article PDFs have no in-app viewer or print control.
items.action: Add an article PDF reading view with a fallback to open/download and an explicit print action.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Publication results credit all authors, including records with three authors.
items.ours: RawShiur supports teacher arrays, but normalize keeps only the first teacher, teacher ID and portrait.
items.action: Preserve every credited speaker/author and make each navigable. Check multi-author articles and panel recordings.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Menus organize material under subject branches and nested sections. Shiur details group topic labels under their parent subject.
items.ours: Topics are flattened to a group and name; the shiur keeps topic names and only one category label.
items.action: Preserve parent paths and per-topic category identity so similarly named topics stay distinguishable.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.feature: Select specific results for batch actions
items.official: Search has Check/Uncheck All, per-result selection and Add to Queue.
items.ours: We already have individual queue actions and Queue results for all visible matching audio. There is no selected subset of results.
items.action: Add optional multi-selection for queue/save/playlist actions, with a clear selection count.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Independent audio/video/text checkboxes; the inspected result set also includes an OT language value.
items.ours: Our format filter selects one format and the language UI offers English or Hebrew only.
items.action: Support a set of formats and additional upstream languages when their labels can be resolved. Do not guess what OT means.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Shiur page exposes a comment count and asks visitors to log in to post.
items.ours: We have no public comments interface. Personal library notes are a different feature.
items.action: A link to the original discussion is a small first step. Native posting would need a supported integration or a separate moderation system.
items.confidence: Public control verified; authenticated behavior untested

items.official: Ask speaker/Ask author control is visible. Clicking it while signed out returns Login to use this feature.
items.ours: No equivalent contact action exists.
items.action: Link to the original action or verified faculty contact route. Do not imply that we can send through YUTorah accounts.
items.confidence: Public control verified; authenticated behavior untested

items.feature: Original YUTorah accounts and library import
items.official: Original site offers Google, Facebook and username/password login, registration and password recovery.
items.ours: Our Google/Supabase identity and library are separate. We already sync our own library, but do not import an original YUTorah account.
items.action: Make the account boundary clear. Investigate export/import only if an upstream supported mechanism exists; adding password login alone would not import the original library.
items.confidence: Public control verified; authenticated behavior untested

items.official: Homepage has seasonal slides and a separate Featured Content carousel, often linking to collection-filtered searches.
items.ours: Editors' picks, featured series, daily learning and recommendations exist. The upstream seasonal campaigns and carousel collections are not mapped.
items.action: Bring in editorial campaign titles, descriptions and destinations, adapting links to supported native searches or collections.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Balk Legacy has tefillah/nusach recordings, quick links and selected series.
items.ours: The general topics library can find some underlying recordings, but there is no equivalent curated landing page.
items.action: Start with a link to the original resource. Recreate a curated page only when it serves an identified audience.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Support YUTorah link and a daily sponsorship dedication.
items.ours: Our footer credits YUTorah but has no support link or sponsorship display.
items.action: Offer the original donation link. Show dedications only if there is a supported, current source for them.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Contact form accepts comments, feature suggestions, questions and errors; footer has Report an Error.
items.ours: We have privacy/account-deletion email contact but no general feedback or report-this-shiur action.
items.action: Add a report action that includes the shiur ID and page URL, with separate destinations for our interface bugs and upstream content errors.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: Original footer has Terms of Use, Privacy Policy, university links and donor attribution.
items.ours: We have our own privacy policy and independent-interface notice, but no terms page/link.
items.action: Decide which terms apply to this independent interface and link the relevant upstream content terms. Preserve the independent status.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

items.official: This is an internal consistency issue found during comparison.
items.ours: About the library says saved shiurim, playlists, progress, topics, series and searches stay only in the browser. Current useAccount invokes cloud-library sync for these items.
items.action: Update About and any On this device labels to distinguish signed-out local storage, signed-in cloud sync and pending offline edits.
items.confidence: Verified public UI and/or current source

present: Live homepage data, editor selections, recently uploaded shiurim and featured series.
Teacher, topic and series directories, search autocomplete, typo handling and natural-language filters.
Duration, language, format, lecture-date ranges, exact phrases, excluded words, ordering and saved searches.
Persistent audio playback, seek, speed, volume, queue, sleep timer and listening resume.
Saved shiurim, personal playlists, listening history, learned status, follows and recommendations.
Own Google account and private library sync are implemented, including topics, series, playlists and progress. Cross-device correctness was not newly tested in this audit.
Teacher push alerts and per-teacher notification preferences.
Official timestamped transcripts, generated study notes and transcript search for the locally indexed completed corpus.
Original source-sheet links, supported video embeds, article downloads and timestamp sharing.
Generated notes exports and extracted-source-sheet download/print tools.
Responsive desktop and mobile interface, installable app metadata, keyboard controls and a privacy page.
